races.title: The rules reveal
races.note: The launch reel. No race run. The track was named by @why_do_you_need_a_name_'s comment, the most-liked name (2 likes).

races.title: King's Warmup
races.note: Three laps. @e.superskyi swung wide on the final bend and won at 13%. @arabella.sk8s ran as a one-off guest on the golden horse, our thank-you for the first ever comment. The favourite finished 8th.

races.title: King's Warmup: banana day
races.note: The crowd voted for the banana peel, and three bananas knocked a horse out on each lap: @johnsnicklefuckthe3rd, @timleahy_08 and @umutozanculha (DNF). @logan_b6682 won at 2%, a long shot.

races.title: King's Warmup: banana storm
races.note: Rain won the crowd vote, so the race ran in a storm. Bananas knocked out @edgar__leung, @_aj_the_equestrian_ and @purplegood38 (DNF). @logpackersfan2710 won at 3% with a custom look (+8%), and @b0bkata_mt took silver from 1%, the longest shot in the field.

races.title: King's Warmup: Figure 8 Crossfire
races.obstacle: banana peel + head-on pile-ups at the crossing
races.note: The crowd chose the Figure 8 (2 of 3 votes). 176 horses, two head-on pile-ups at the crossing: @_cooperp, @_aj_the_equestrian_, @amelia.wood13, @cathleen.j.isidro on lap 1, @certified.waffless, @und3rarainysky, @zakhary__55 on the final lap; @idk1863eg slipped off the track. Bananas knocked out @_wirldy, @logpackersfan2710, @davidosky378 (DNF). @f3y_nman won by a nose at 0.6%, @moniquekulit took silver, and like-only @juan_.cl7 took bronze at 0.4%. Followers ran at 1.5x weight.

races.title: King's Warmup: Figure 8 Fire
races.note: The crowd voted fire for the crossing. 1,284 horses, two fires and a banana storm: 60 horses bananaed out (DNF). Photo finish: @simply_horses_hamza won by a nose at 1%, @pupa.011 took silver and @_gl88k bronze. Our 1,000th follower @kaszanderka_official raced with a one-of-a-kind ring.
